component: Panorama display order versus folder move

quotes.text:
/**
   * Move a folder to a different position among its siblings. Yes, passing in
   * the parent folder is redundant here, but it makes reading the code easier.
   *
   * This function should be called by the UI, nothing else is affected.
   * If `before` is 0 or missing, the child will be moved to the end of the
   * child list.
   */
  void moveFolderWithin(in unsigned long long parent,
                        in unsigned long long child,
                        [optional] in unsigned long long before);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current moveFolderWithin changes sibling order, with absent or 0 beforeId meaning the end. It saves a contiguous ordinal sequence starting at 1 and updates cached ordinals after each successful statement. moveFolderTo changes the parent and clears the moved folder ordinal. The interface reserves the sibling operation for UI display ordering. These operations do not themselves move mail folders on a server, and the inspected SaveOrdinals loop is not proof of atomic multi-row success. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Preserve sibling reordering and server reparenting as separate operations
